scope: Bounded exact calibration of Gallai/degree-list reducibility on the 18 distinct published 508-vertex fixed-L residual supports, with a complete C4/diamond census in the 303-point pool. No H574 deletion and no quantified solver.
exploration_before_plan: motif_probe, historical_probe and gallai_probe motivated this frozen validation; preliminary zero-rejection outcome is not presented as a blind test.
success_criterion: Determine exactly how many of the 18 historical residuals violate the full low-degree Gallai condition; certify either gain or its absence by direct witnesses and all degree-four components.
validation: Reconstruct all exact geometry from pinned inputs.
Directly verify the 18 existing positive colourings and common base-clause intersections.
Check all degree-four components as forests, using both traversal and a separate cycle-union check.
Enumerate every induced pool C4 or diamond by two distinct complete traversals, comparing exact sets.
Compare motif and forest checks with brute force on all 64 labelled simple graphs on four vertices and all 1024 on five vertices.
stop_policy: Publish or checkpoint this calibration and its go/no-go disposition; do not launch another support extraction, broader motif order, or QBF phase.
